shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب

notes: two «ح» branches each write Yahya ibn Ya'mar; the Ibn Umar and Umar names are written once after the last «ح», so they are the shared tail
«- وهذا حديثه -» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبي» in the second branch is a relation link
«ابن بريدة» is not merged with «عبد الله بن بريدة» (no identity judgement)
two sayings: Yahya's account of Ma'bad (Ibn Umar answers) and the Gabriel saying with its own «حدثني أبي» isnad through Umar: a ruling case (rule 11); the tail reads both as one route
